# garage_admin_token (Data Source)

Looks up an admin token by ID or name, or the token the provider uses when neither is set. The secret is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_admin_token" "current" {}

output "provider_scope" {
  value = data.garage_admin_token.current.scope
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Token ID. Null for the tokens of the daemon configuration.
- `name` (String) Name of the token.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `expiration` (String)
- `expired` (Boolean)
- `scope` (List of String) Admin endpoints the token can call.
